procuration_[hermes].name: Procuration [Hermes]
procuration_[hermes].description:
- Turn Start: at 9 Stack, a powerful Skill becomes available
- Can be gained up to (Unlock stage + 2) Stack per turn
Max Stack: 9
· At below Unlock - II, this effect's maximum stack is limited to 8

bullet_-_solitude.name: Bullet - Solitude
bullet_-_solitude.description:
- Unique Ammo
- Max Capacity: 6
Spent by certain Skills
- This Ammo's count cannot be gained or lost due to external effects

spore_round_[base].name: Spore Round [Base]
spore_round_[base].description:
- Unique Ammo
- Max Stack: 10
- Spent when using certain Skills
- Some attacks cancel if lacking Ammo
- When spent, inflict 2 Spore on target On Hit

spore_round_[buckshot].name: Spore Round [BuckShot]
spore_round_[buckshot].description:
- Unique Ammo
- Max Stack: 6
- Spent when using certain Skills
- Some attacks cancel if lacking Ammo
- When spent, inflict 3 Spore on target On Hit

reload_[germination].name: Reload [Germination]
reload_[germination].description:
- Effect applied to Spore Round (Unique Ammo)
- Consume ((16 - sum of Spore Round) / 2) SP(rounded down), reset both Spore Round [Base] and Spore Round [Buckshot] to 0 Stacks, and gain them up to max Stacks

aggro.name: Aggro
aggro.description: More likely to be targeted by enemies.

unfocused_volley.name: Unfocused Volley
unfocused_volley.description:
- When this Skill flips Coins, each Coin flips against a random enemy among its targets
· The first Coin always targets the main target
· All 'On Hit' effects and all damage dealt by each Coin are inflicted only against the random target the Coin selected

ammo.name: Ammo
ammo.description: Spent by certain skills. Some attacks cancel if lacking Ammo.

ammo_-_atelier_logic.name: Ammo - Atelier Logic
ammo_-_atelier_logic.description:
Unique Ammo
Atelier Logic Workshop Special Ammo
- This Ammo's Count cannot be gained or lost due to external effects

discard.name: Discard
discard.description:
- Delete Skills that fit the condition and are selectable during the Chaining Phase on the Dashboard. (Defensive & E.G.O Skills do not count. Does not delete the Skill from the upcoming Skills list)
- Discarded Skills will not activate Skill effects or Coin effects other than effects from Discard, and will not give E.G.O resources.

responsibility.name: Responsibility
responsibility.description:
- Max Value: 1
- Clash Power +1
- Deal +20% more damage
- Take +20% more damage

sp_heal_efficiency.name: SP Heal Efficiency
sp_heal_efficiency.description:
Amount of SP healed due to the Identity's 'Base factors increasing Sanity(SP)'
(That is, +(Potency) to all SP healed by allies this turn (Potency may be a negative number))

sp_loss_efficiency.name: SP Loss Efficiency
sp_loss_efficiency.description:
Amount of SP lost due to the Identity's 'Base factors decreasing Sanity(SP)'
(That is, +(Potency) to all SP lost by allies this turn (Potency may be a negative number))

insight.name: Insight
insight.description: The rank of the last Skill Discarded by the unit with this effect (Base Value:1)

k_corp_ampule.name: K Corp Ampule
k_corp_ampule.description:
Turn Start: At less than 4 Count, heal by (Count * 5)% of Max HP
At 4+ Count, this unit dies

magic_bullet.name: Magic Bullet
magic_bullet.description:
- Max: 7
- Value changes depending on certain Skill effects.
- The higher the value, the higher the Base Power and Coin Power of Skill 3

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Lose all currently owned Ammo, and reload back to full

the_living_&_the_departed.name: The Living & The Departed
the_living_&_the_departed.description:
- Unique Ammo
- The sum of Potency and Count maxes out at 20.
- Consumed for certain Skills.
- Whether The Living(Potency) or The Departed(Count) will be consumed for each shot is randomly determined
- Some attacks cancel if this unit runs out of ammo.

final_augment.name: Final Augment
final_augment.description: Turn Start: Gain 3 Attack Power Up, Defense Power Up, and Haste; die when count reaches zero.

courier_trunk.name: Courier Trunk
courier_trunk.description:
- Base Value: 0
- Turn Start: gain 3 Stack
- Stack does not expire upon Retreat; it is stored instead
- At 10+ Stack: raise Min & Max Speed values by 1
- At 20+ Stack: Gain 1 Clash Power Up and 1 Damage Type DMG Up
· (Courier Trunk - Rodion: Slash DMG Up)
· (Courier Trunk - Sinclair: Blunt DMG Up)
- At 30+ Stack:
· On Skill Use, take (Stack/3)% HP damage and (Stack/3) SP damage
· On Turn End, take (Stack/2)% HP damage and (Stack/2) SP damage
(applies before Retreat)

strategic_r&r_mode.name: Strategic R&R Mode
strategic_r&r_mode.description:
- Turn End: Recover from Stagger and Retreat from the Encounter (excluding forced Staggers; does not count as death)
· In Chain Battles, give this unit's Slots to a Substituted unit and move to the rearmost place in the Backup units' Deployment order (escape from the Encounter entirely if there are no other Backup Units remaining to swap places with next turn. When returning to battle, return in the order they retreated in)
· When returning to battle, return with the same amount of HP and SP this unit had when it retreated, and eliminate all effects on self save for a select few (if this unit had less than 0 SP when retreating, reset SP to 0 instead)

surgery.name: Makeshift Surgery
surgery.description:
Die when Count reaches 5.
Reduce Max HP by 20% (per Count).
Deal +20% (per Count) damage.
At the start of the turn, gain Haste by the effect's Count.

blubberbubble.name: Blubberbubble
blubberbubble.description:
- This effect counts as a 'Shield Management' effect.
- Turn End: Reduce Count by 1
- This unit does not lose Shield at Turn End as long as it has the Blubberbubble effect (unless depleted by damage or effect)
- If the Shield affected by Blubberbubble breaks due to taking damage, inflict 4 Sinking Potency/Count against the attacker. (How much of that '4' value is Potency or Count is randomly determined)
- This unit can stack their Shield value by stacking this effect. However, as long as Blubberbubble is in effect, the Shield value cannot exceed 60% of this unit's Max HP.

amplitude_conversion.name: Amplitude Conversion
amplitude_conversion.description:
Converts Tremor or already converted Tremor on target to a different kind of Tremor
Potency and Count values do not change over the conversion.

amplitude_entanglement.name: Amplitude Entanglement
amplitude_entanglement.description:
- Fuses the effects of the Tremor type added by Amplitude Entanglement and the Tremor type currently on the target together under Tremor - Superposition.
- Potency and Count values do not change over Entanglement.
- When triggering Amplitude Conversion on Tremor - Superposition, it activates as Amplitude Entanglement instead.
- Turn End: converted into base Tremor.

clashable_guard.name: Clashable Guard
clashable_guard.description:
- On Clash Win: raise the target's Stagger Threshold by this unit's final Clash Power.
- On Clash Lose: when hit, reduce the attacker's Final Skill Power by this unit's Final Power.
- On Clash Lose: does not gain Final Power from the following sources: Resonance and the Level disparity against the Attack Skill

unbreakable_coin.name: Unbreakable Coin
unbreakable_coin.description:
- This Coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with this Coin after getting hit.
- Upon Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

excision_coin.name: Excision Coin
excision_coin.description:
- This Coin can destroy Unbreakable Coins in a Clash.
- This Coin does not break upon Clash Lose.
- If an Attack Skill has this Coin, attack with the Coin after getting hit.
- On Clash Lose, fix the Coin Power of the unbroken Coin to 1

bloodfeast.name: Bloodfeast
bloodfeast.description:
- Max Value: 999
- Stores all Bleed damage dealt in this zone
- Resets when moving to a different zone
- This value is shared by all characters
- Among allies, if there is a higher Kindred who also consumes Bloodfeast in the same turn, this unit cannot consume Bloodfeast until that ally consumes it first.

bloodfeast_consumed_(shared).name: Bloodfeast Consumed (shared)
bloodfeast_consumed_(shared).description: Total Bloodfeast consumed in this Encounter

overheated_fuel.name: Overheated Fuel
overheated_fuel.description:
Max Stack: 100
Consuming District 12 Fuel in Overheated Fuel State consumes Overheated Fuel instead
Consuming Overheated Fuel also counts as consuming District 12 Fuel
At over 50 Stack, become District 12 Fuel

district_12_fuel.name: District 12 Fuel
district_12_fuel.description:
Max Stack: 100
Consumed by certain Skills.
At 50- Stack, become Overheated Fuel

shallow_exhale.name: Shallow Exhale
shallow_exhale.description:
- Max Value: 1
- At 20+ Poise Potency, gain +1 Poise Count as well whenever this unit gains Poise Potency with Skill and Coin effects
- Expires at Turn End

dark_cloud.name: Dark Cloud
dark_cloud.description:
Max Stack: 1
Converts all of this unit's Base Attack Skill Coins used this turn into Unbreakable Coins, prevents damage from Staggering this unit until Skill End, and inflict +1 more of Bleed effects
On Clash Lose: gain Final Power +3
Turn End: this effect expires

assist_defense.name: Assist Defense
assist_defense.description:
- Max Stack: 3
- When an ally is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self; then, use the unique Skill that activates for Assist Defense
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- Does not activate for allies who equipped Defense Skills
- Expires at Turn End

tianjiu_star's_blade.name: Tianjiu Star's Blade
tianjiu_star's_blade.description:
- Max Stack: 20
- At 10+ Stack: at Turn End, gain 1 Haste next turn
- Used for certain Skills

launcher_[始].name: Launcher [始]
launcher_[始].description:
- Max Stack: 6
- Number of turns this unit spent active in the Encounter
- Expires upon Retreat
- Gain 1 Stack at Turn End

ready_[待].name: Ready [待]
ready_[待].description:
- Max Stack: 3
- Number of turns this unit spent in Retreat or as a Backup unit

savage_tigermark_round.name: Savage Tigermark Round
savage_tigermark_round.description:
- Unique Ammo
- At 8+ (cumulative sum of Tigermark Rounds and Savage Tigermark Rounds spent), gain Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星] instead of Tiantui Star [天退星] from this unit's Passive
· Cumulative Rounds spent: X
- Actives the same way as Tigermark Round does
- Max Capacity: 8

tigermark_round.name: Tigermark Round
tigermark_round.description:
- Unique Ammo
- At 8+ (cumulative sum of Tigermark Rounds and Savage Tigermark Rounds spent), gain Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星] instead of Tiantui Star [天退星] from this unit's Passive
· Cumulative Rounds spent: X
- Max Capacity: 12

torn_memory.name: Torn Memory
torn_memory.description:
- Max Value: 7
- Used for certain Skills

your_will_guides_my_blade..name: Your Will Guides My Blade
your_will_guides_my_blade..description:
- If unit A applies this effect to unit B: Unit B follows up with an Unopposed Attack with its Skill 1 against the same enemy unit A attacked with its Skill. Activates at unit A's Skill Attack End.
- The Skill used as an Assist Attack does not affect Unit B's upcoming Skills list.

exalted_command.name: Exalted Command
exalted_command.description:
- If unit A applies this effect to unit B: Unit B follows up with an Unopposed Attack with its Base Skill 3 against the same enemy unit A attacked with its Skill. Activates at unit A's Attack End. (Does not activate as Empowered Skills)
- The Skill used as an Assist Attack does not affect Unit B's upcoming Skills list.
- Does not activate if affected ally's Skill 3 is not unlocked.

lordsguard.name: LordsGuard
lordsguard.description:
- Unique Assist Defense
- Max Stack: 1
- When The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self; then, copy and use The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu's 'Lordsguard' Skill
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- This effect counts as Assist Defense, and is counted toward calculating Assist Defense Stacks
- Expires at Turn End

arrow_-_shi.name: Arrow-Shi
arrow_-_shi.description:
- Min Capacity: 0
- Max Capacity: 4
- Arrows spent by certain Skills

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.description:
- Max Value: 1
- Become Immobilized
- Take 10 + (Charge Potency x 5)% less damage (max 25%)
- Turn Start: Gain Charge Barrier based on Charge Potency on self (max 5)
- Turn End: Gain +10 Charge Count and 2 Attack Power Up next turn, and lose this effect
- Gain Aggro to this unit's leftmost Slot based on Charge Potency on self (max 5)
- When hit, gain +1 Charge Count and 1 Load next turn (max 5 per turn)
- If this unit is in Panic or E.G.O Corrosion at Turn Start, or if this unit is Staggered, lose this effect

hand_-_pine_crane_suit.name: Hand - Pine Crane Suit
hand_-_pine_crane_suit.description:
- Skill 1 Base Power +2
When this unit equips and uses a Wrath Base Attack Skill or E.G.O Skill on its leftmost Skill Slot, activate the "forming a Hand" effects on the "Koi-Koi" Passive

hand_-_susuki_grass_suit.name: Hand - Susuki Grass Suit
hand_-_susuki_grass_suit.description:
- Skill 2 Base Power +1
When this unit equips and uses a Sloth Base Attack Skill or E.G.O Skill on its leftmost Skill Slot, activate the "forming a Hand" effects on the "Koi-Koi" Passive

hand_-_blue_sakura_suit.name: Hand - Blue Sakura Suit
hand_-_blue_sakura_suit.description:
- Skill 3 Base Power +1
When this unit equips and uses a Gloom Base Attack Skill or E.G.O Skill on its leftmost Skill Slot, activate the "forming a Hand" effects on the "Koi-Koi" Passive

prescript:_[paper_slip]_i.name: Prescript [Paper Slip] I
prescript:_[paper_slip]_i.description:
Use a Skill marked with Mark of the Prescript or hit a target with a marked Skill.
- Turn Start: At 0~2 Grace of the Prescript, gain this effect
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 3
The Prescripts are delivered by many means, their medium determined with finality akin to divine prophecy. Those who receive them hold no power over how they arrive.

prescript:_[paper_slip]_ii.name: Prescript [Paper Slip] II
prescript:_[paper_slip]_ii.description:
Hit a target with a Skill marked with Mark of the Prescript.
- Turn Start: At 3~5 Grace of the Prescript, gain this effect
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 6
The Prescripts are delivered by many means, their medium determined with finality akin to divine prophecy. Those who receive them hold no power over how they arrive.

prescript:_[paper_slip]_iii.name: Prescript [Paper Slip] III
prescript:_[paper_slip]_iii.description:
Hit a target with E.G.O Awakening Skill or 'Skill 3' marked with Mark of the Prescript.
- Turn Start: At 6~8 Grace of the Prescript, gain this effect
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 9
The Prescripts are delivered by many means, their medium determined with finality akin to divine prophecy. Those who receive them hold no power over how they arrive.

prescript:_[paper_slip]_iv.name: Prescript [Paper Slip] IV
prescript:_[paper_slip]_iv.description:
Eliminate all enemies before the next Prescript arrives.
- Turn Start: At 9 Grace of the Prescript, gain this effect
The Prescripts are delivered by many means, their medium determined with finality akin to divine prophecy. Those who receive them hold no power over how they arrive.

the_prescript's_target.name: The Prescript's Target
the_prescript's_target.description:
- Take +10% damage from The Index units
- This effect is applied to a single target every turn regardless of the number of The Index units deployed

mark_of_the_prescript.name: Mark of the Prescript
mark_of_the_prescript.description: - Apply Mark of the Prescript to a Base Attack Skill on this unit's Dashboard

lca_fracture_round.name: LCA Fracture Round
lca_fracture_round.description:
- Unique Ammo
- Max Capacity: 16
- Spent by certain Skills
- Some attacks cancel if lacking Ammo

prescript:_[device]_i.name: Prescript [Device] I
prescript:_[device]_i.description:
Use a Skill marked with Mark of the Prescript or hit a target with a marked Skill.
- Turn Start: Gain this effect when this unit has no Unlock
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 3
The Prescripts are delivered by many means, their medium determined with finality akin to divine prophecy. Those who receive them hold no power over how they arrive.

prescript:_[device]_ii.name: Prescript [Device] II
prescript:_[device]_ii.description:
Hit a target with a Skill marked with Mark of the Prescript.
- Turn Start: Gain this effect when this unit has Unlock - I
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 6
The Prescripts are delivered by many means, their medium determined with finality akin to divine prophecy. Those who receive them hold no power over how they arrive.

prescript:_[device]_iii.name: Prescript [Device] III
prescript:_[device]_iii.description:
Hit a target with E.G.O Awakening Skill, or, in Effloresced E.G.O::Procuration state, 'Skill 3' marked with Mark of the Prescript.
- Turn Start: Gain this effect when this unit has Unlock - II
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 9
The Prescripts are delivered by many means, their medium determined with finality akin to divine prophecy. Those who receive them hold no power over how they arrive.

prescript:_[device]_iv.name: Prescript [Device] IV
prescript:_[device]_iv.description:
Eliminate all enemies before the next Prescript arrives.
- Turn Start: Gain this effect when this unit has Unlock - III
The Prescripts are delivered by many means, their medium determined with finality akin to divine prophecy. Those who receive them hold no power over how they arrive.

melee_support.name: Melee Support
melee_support.description:
If unit A applied this effect to unit B: Unit B follows up with an Unopposed Attack with the 'Melee Support' Skill against the same enemy that attacked Unit A. Activates at Unit A's Attack End.
- The Skill used due to the 'Melee Support' effect does not affect Unit B's upcoming Skills list.

lamp.name: Lamp
lamp.description:
- Max Stack: 8
- Turn End: Gain 1 Bind next turn for every 2 Stack (max 4)
- Turn End: At max Stack, if there are enemies on the field, consume all Stack to activate the following effects next turn:
· Gain +10 Aggro to the leftmost Slot
· Inflict 3 Dazzle to the enemy(Core) with the most current HP

viewing_the_tableau.name: Viewing the Tableau
viewing_the_tableau.description:
- If The House of Spiders: The Ring Apprentice Faust is on the field, gain 2 Protection at Turn Start
- Turn End: Lose 2 Stack

fixed_panic.name: Fixed Panic
fixed_panic.description: This unit's Panic Type does not change when inflicted with an effect that changes Panic Types. Instead, this unit is inflicted with an effect that is inflicted against targets without SP.

total_bloodfeast_consumed.name: Total Bloodfeast Consumed
total_bloodfeast_consumed.description:
- Max Value: 999
- Displays the total amount of Bloodfeast consumed in this Encounter

target_spotted.name: Target Spotted
target_spotted.description:
If unit A applied this effect to unit B: Unit B follows up with an Unopposed Attack with its Skill 2 against the same enemy unit A attacked with its Skill. Activates at Unit A's Attack End.
- The Skill used due to this effect does not affect Unit B's upcoming Skills list.

prescript.name: Prescript
prescript.description:
- Receive 'Prescript: [Paper Slip]' under specific conditions
The Prescripts are delivered by many means, their medium determined with finality akin to divine prophecy. Those who receive them hold no power over how they arrive.

blazing.name: Blazing
blazing.description:
- Min & Max Speed +1
- This turn's first-used Base Attack Skill gains Final Power +2
- Take 2% HP damage On Hit with the affected Skill (max 10%; this damage does not Stagger or reduce this unit's HP below 1)
- Expires at Turn End

dihui_star's_blade.name: Dihui Star's Blade
dihui_star's_blade.description:
- Max Stack: 70
- Total sum of Bladetrail [Afterimage] Stacks inflicted by this unit
- Can gain up to 25 Stack per turn
Etch a mark into the earth. Such is the purpose this blade was made to serve.
Into this sword was poured the light of a star, so that something may be left behind in this land.

hornet_[shotgun].name: Hornet [Shotgun]
hornet_[shotgun].description:
Current Mode: Hornet [Shotgun]
Instead of deferring the definition to its rifle-form, gaze into the core essence of "Hornet."
epoché

réflexion.name: Réflexion
réflexion.description:
- Max Stack: 2
- Cannot use "Critique" during the turn this unit has this effect
- Turn Start: Heal 5 SP
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack
- When this effect expires, gain L'Hommage next turn equal to the number of The Ring Student Identities on the field

volatile_passion.name: Volatile Passion
volatile_passion.description:
- On Hit, inflict 1 Burn
- If the main target has Burn, Final Power +1
- When hit, if this unit had a Defense Skill chained at Combat Start, inflict 1 Burn per hit against the attacker for the turn
- Turn End: lose (# of turns spent in Volatile E.G.O state x 5) SP. (Max SP Loss: 40)

rising_fever.name: Rising Fever
rising_fever.description:
- Lose 1 Stack when meeting one of the following conditions:
· Using the "Stamp of Vengeance" Skill (including activation via Counter)
· At Turn End after activating 6+ Envy A-Reson.
- At 0 Stack, use the "Time to Unpack!" Skill

sealed_sword.name: Sealed Sword
sealed_sword.description:
- Turn End: Gain 2 Haste next turn
- Blunt Base Skills deal +2% damage for every 4 Bleed on target (max 10%)
- On final Coin Hit using Base Skills, if target has 20+ Bleed, deal (10% of the Coin's final damage) Blunt damage (rounded down)

first_seal_removed.name: First Seal Removed
first_seal_removed.description:
- Turn End: Gain 1 Haste next turn
- Blunt Base Skills deal +2% damage for every 4 (Burn + Bleed) on target (max 10%)
- On final Coin Hit using Base Skills, if target has 20+ (Burn + Bleed), deal (10% of the Coin's final damage) Blunt damage (rounded down)

second_seal_removed.name: Second Seal Removed
second_seal_removed.description:
- Turn End: Gain 1 Haste next turn
- Blunt Base Skills deal 2% damage for every 4 (Burn + Bleed) on target (max 10%)
- On final Coin Hit using Base Skills, if target has 20+ (Burn + Bleed), deal (10% of the Coin's final damage) Slash damage (rounded down)

lævateinn.name: Lævateinn
lævateinn.description:
- Turn Start: Inflict 3 Burn on all units on the field
- Replace this unit's Base Skills with Lævateinn-exclusive Skills corresponding to each Skill's rank
- Blunt Base Skills deal +2% damage for every 4 (Burn + Bleed) on target (max 10%)
- On final Coin Hit using Base Skills, if target has 20+ (Burn + Bleed), deal (10% of the Coin's final damage) Pierce damage (rounded down)

hyped-up.name: Hyped-up
hyped-up.description:
- Max Stack: 3
- For every Stack, deal +5% damage with Wrath and Lust Skills
- When hit, raise this unit's Stagger Threshold by (5 x Stack)
- Expires at Turn End

curio.name: Curio
curio.description: When certain conditions are fulfilled, replace this effect with 'Art Medium'

self_resonance_circuitry.name: Self Resonance Circuitry
self_resonance_circuitry.description:
Total sum of Charge Count currently owned by all allies
Cumulative Charge Count consumed by allies: X
On Hit with a Skill: deal +(sum of Charge Count on all allies / 3)% damage
All allies gain 1 Offense Level Up for every 100 cumulative Charge Count consumed by allies (max 30)

game_target.name: Game Target
game_target.description: - Take +15% damage from Base Skills used by The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather Rodion

scorchfield.name: Scorchfield
scorchfield.description:
- Stores all Burn damage dealt in this zone
- Resets when moving to a different zone
- This value is shared by all characters
Heat turns air into a breeze, a gust, a firestorm, scorching the forest with abandon as men and beasts alike depart.

escape_apparatus.name: Escape Apparatus
escape_apparatus.description:
- When this unit takes damage that brings its HP to 10, this unit's HP does not drop below 10 for the turn
- Turn End after the above effect activates: Recover from Stagger and Retreat from the Encounter (excluding forced Staggers; does not count as death; in Encounters where Retreat is disabled, the Retreat effect does not activate and expires at Turn End)
- In Chain Battles, give this unit's Slots to a Substituted unit and move to the rearmost place in the Backup units' Deployment order (escape from the Encounter entirely if there are no other Backup Units remaining to swap places with next turn. When returning to battle, return in the order they retreated in)
· When returning to battle, return with the same amount of HP and SP this unit had when it retreated, and eliminate all effects on self save for a select few (if this unit had less than 0 SP when retreating, reset SP to 0 instead)
'… Live.'

fire_butterfly_coffin.name: Fire Butterfly Coffin
fire_butterfly_coffin.description:
- Max Stack: 30
- Can gain up to 20 Stacks per turn
- On Base Skill Hit: Gain 2 Stacks
- Turn End: At 20+ Stacks, gain Burn next turn equal to half of surplus Stacks past 20 (rounded down)
· At 30 Stacks, Gain 5 Burn and +2 Burn Count instead
"Heated to a smoldering temperature within the coffin are butterflies, the kaleidoscope spilling forth to melt and tear the target apart.
"This type of weapon is still too premature for you to wield, Sinclair, but it is advisable that you familiarize yourself with its properties."
"The array of blades within the coffin affords considerable convenience in circumstances where time constraints prove solitary handling of requests impossible, or in combat against multiple adversaries."

changing_room.name: Changing Room
changing_room.description:
- Max Stack: 2
- Fix this unit's Speed to 1
- Take -50% damage from Skills
- Immediately after gaining this effect, remove Stagger Thresholds; when Staggered, recover from Stagger
- Turn Start: Gain 10 Aggro
- When hit, gain +1 Pulsation Count (20 times per turn)
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack
- Cannot Retreat
- Cannot enter E.G.O Corrosion; instead, enters default Panic state (is affected by Panic-changing effects)
- While in this state, aside from its exclusive Skill "As the Voice Says, I Gladly Withdraw into Myself", cannot equip Defense Skills or E.G.O Skills
Though it has become hardier, it has now become passive. When viewed through the lens of Le Rouge, however durable something might have become, what is passive is always fragile.
But one must first come to a halt in order to usher in change. And that is what makes this process painful.

full_makeover.name: Full Makeover
full_makeover.description:
- Min & Max Speed +1
- Max HP increased by 25%
- Take -10% damage from Skills
- Base Skills inflict +1 Bleed Potency on enemies
Though she has emerged from the cocoon, she has failed to truly metamorphose—as that process involves the disintegration of the self. Still, the process has managed to boost her physical abilities.

duality.name: Duality
duality.description:
- Skills can target allied Identities
- Upon auto-targeting Skills, or in Regular Encounters, prioritize the ally with the earliest Deployment Order
· If target is an ally, the attack does not hit, and does not trigger Defense Skills (including Clashable Defense Skills)
- If target is an ally, activate this Skill at Combat Start

joint_combo.name: Joint Combo
joint_combo.description: - If the pertinent Identity is on the field, alive, and isn't immobilized, activate the linked effects (does not activate if the pertinent Identity is in any of the following states: all types of immobilized states, E.G.O Corrosions, and Staggers)

buffet.name: Buffet
buffet.description:
- Max Value: 999
- This value is increased by (actual HP healed / 10) whenever allies' or enemies' HP is healed on the field
· Rounded up for each instance
· Healing from E.G.O Gifts does not count
- This value is shared by all characters
- Resets when moving to a different zone
The Buffet of flesh and meat is served. Let this be a feasting hall for all.

attending_the_divine.name: Attending the Divine
attending_the_divine.description:
- Unique Assist Defense
- Max Stack: 1
- When Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self
· Then, copy and use Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair's "La Garde"
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- This effect counts as Assist Defense, and is counted toward calculating Assist Defense Stacks
- Turn End: This effect expires
Let us attend to our new God.

weathered_pride.name: Weathered Pride
weathered_pride.description:
- Max Stack: 999
- Can only be gained up to 500 Stacks per turn
